**Current**
- His preseason has been mixed. Marcus Smart outplayed him in a game they both started. With Kevin Durant back, he played well in about 18 minutes. (fact, 2026-10-15; [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=1669), [10-10](https://youtu.be/hviT4hzYNME?t=1828), [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=1411))
- Take him only as a late upside flyer, around picks 110 to 150 in drafts. In an auction, Josh sees him as a 1 USD player. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [10-13](https://youtu.be/EogBYa24Gto?t=1626), [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=1411), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=1996), [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1688), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1949), [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=3555))
- Houston's guard group is crowded. Fred VanVleet is back, and the Rockets added Marcus Smart and Bogdan Bogdanovic. (fact, 2026-10-13; [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=1671), [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=1066), [07-02](https://youtu.be/P6TNP-g0wzY?t=1443), [09-15](https://youtu.be/KPdD91Oo8-U?t=2090), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1952), [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=1659), [09-15](https://youtu.be/KPdD91Oo8-U?t=2090), [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=1502))
- Several experts think Udoka dislikes him and will not change his mind. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=1996), [10-10](https://youtu.be/hviT4hzYNME?t=1828), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1952), [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=1671), [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=1497))
- Experts expect fewer minutes than last season. Projections run from about 18 to 26 minutes, and his minutes path is unclear. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=205), [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1688), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1331), [10-13](https://youtu.be/EogBYa24Gto?t=1626), [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=1671), [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=1066), [10-12](https://youtu.be/w66x_I_MaQ8?t=1554))
- If he started and played 28 to 30 minutes, experts see him as a top 40 to top 50 player. They think the chance of that role is low. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=1996), [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=1679), [09-09](https://youtu.be/7BllEsdNLoM?t=2582), [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=1497))
- Projected starting lineups do not include him. The projected starters are VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Kevin Durant, Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=328), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=357))
- Ime Udoka blamed him for defensive mistakes and pulls him quickly when he makes them. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=205), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1144))
- His ESPN rank is far too high. Lloyd doubts he breaks the top 100 and calls him his biggest fade on ESPN. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1688), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=2453))
- Udoka plays his starters heavy minutes and gives little room to weak defenders. That limits minutes for a bench guard like him. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=146), [09-09](https://youtu.be/7BllEsdNLoM?t=2451), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1152))
- With our March 28 end date, the Rockets play a weak 3-3-4 schedule in the fantasy playoffs, 10 games over three weeks. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1970))
- The Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2011))
- Experts see almost no path to a starting role unless there are big injuries. (verdict, 2026-09-17; [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=1016), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=1949))
- His minutes are expected to swing from game to game. He should play more when he is hot from three and less in other games. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1331))
- Houston is predicted to win 54 games. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1780))

**Durable**
- His fantasy profile is built on steals, blocks for a guard and lots of threes, plus good free throw shooting on low volume and solid assists. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1510), [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=986), [08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=2101), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1082), stats)
- He is small and struggles on defense. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1510), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1144))
- Season-total 9-cat rankings overrate him because they reward games played. Lloyd calls that ranking misleading for head-to-head. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1474), [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=968))
- He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [08-30](https://youtu.be/Alwse2uXzD4?t=2101), [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1474))
- He picks up his dribble too often and is soft with the ball. He needs to get stronger. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1309))
- He is a good three-point shooter. He shot 41% from three last season, and his two-point percentage rose from 37 to 49. (fact, 2026-07-16; [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=986), [07-16](https://youtu.be/-y6p5PYLf00?t=1301), [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1082))

**Tags**
- Current: `coach distrust` (Experts say Ime Udoka dislikes him and pulls him quickly for defensive mistakes), `minutes competition` (Fred VanVleet, Marcus Smart, Bogdan Bogdanovic and Amen Thompson), `role down` (Expected to lose minutes from last season's 26 per game), `flyer` (Late upside pick in case he plays 20 to 25 minutes or starts), `bust candidate` (ESPN rank near 60 is far too high), `sites disagree on price` (Yahoo rank 142 and 1 USD value, ESPN rank 62 and 7 USD value), `bad playoff schedule` (3-3-4, 10 games in weeks 19 to 21 with a March 28 end), `few back-to-backs` (14 back-to-backs), `winning team` (Predicted 54 wins)
- Durable: `defensive liability` (Small and struggles on defense, which costs him minutes under Udoka), `9-cat fluff` (Season-total 9-cat rank about 30th last season against 93rd in head-to-head), `category league player` (93rd in head-to-head and 127th in points leagues last season), `fits every build` (No category flagged weak), `heavy starter minutes` (Udoka leans on starters, which shrinks a bench guard's minutes), `defense-first` (Udoka gives little room for error to weak defenders)

**Note.** Spend no more than 1 to 3 USD on him, as one of the last players you take. Yahoo values him at 1 USD and ranks him 142nd, Josh calls him a 1 USD player, and ESPN's 7 USD value and rank of 62 are what the experts fade. He went for 4 USD in our league last season. He fits any build that wants steals and threes from a bench guard, but the Rockets' weak 10-game playoff schedule and Udoka's distrust cap his value. In the first two weeks, check whether he stays near 25 minutes behind VanVleet, Smart and Bogdanovic, and drop him quickly if he settles around 18.
